title: Record a regression
responsibility: Run and preserve the failing-test commit or its unchanged passing fix.

inputs.name: recordRegression.input
inputs.description: Loop, evidence phase, committed revision, tests and optional command, assertion, units and timeout to record.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.root
inputs.description: Repository whose retained Git evidence contains the required regression checkpoint.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.loop
inputs.description: Loop identifier whose red or paired green proof is required.

inputs.name: requireRegressionProof.step
inputs.description: Loop step being completed; determines the required proof phase and tested revision.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.root
inputs.description: Repository containing the loop state and retained regression evidence.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.state
inputs.description: Loop state to validate and opt into committed regression enforcement when red begins.

inputs.name: enforceRegressionStep.step
inputs.description: Step being advanced, used to require the appropriate recorded checkpoint.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: A commit-linked result with the observed outcome and immutable evidence

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: Refuses mixed product/test commits, changed tests, invalid phases or unsuccessful proof.
